subject: Military Zone WG - Strait of Georgia
text:
Military Zone WG - Strait of Georgia
Military Exercise Area WG will be active for surface, subsurface and air activities from 05 Nov 2026 1530 UTC to 05 Nov 2026 2330 UTC. During operations WG is extremely hazardous and closed to marine traffic. Entry is prohibited pursuant to the Defence Controlled Access Area Regulations. Safe passage is available within 0.5nm North of Winchelsea Island and within 0.5 nm East of Ballenas Island. Contact Winchelsea Island Control on VHF Channel 10 for additional information. Ref: NOTMAR F35 - Annual Edition.
